critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck cylinder geometry along its longitudinal axis. Increase the length of the hump by 40% to ensure it extends significantly further back toward the rear fuselage, past the cockpit area, matching the reference profile's elongated silhouette.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck hump ends very close to the cockpit area.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck cylinder

discrepancies.observed: A sharp transition between the cockpit and the top deck structure.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous curve blending into the main fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: smooth/round the front edge of the hump geometry

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck appears very narrow relative to the lower fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck has a substantial, wide profile that tapers gradually.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase diameter of the upper-deck cylinder

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively low and flat against the top of the plane.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent, high-profile 'hump' characteristic of the 747.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical height of the upper-deck cylinder
